rules:
Sort the audit's 309 cause families into lanes by real risk, then into batches that can run side by side.

Owner, 27 Nov 2026: "A: re-sort first". Reads docs/system-map/FAMILIES.json and findings.jsonl; writes
docs/system-map/FIX-PLAN.json and FIX-PLAN.md. Re-runnable: the plan is derived, never typed by hand.

Lanes (No Gaps framework, skill change-360):
  full     - design note, goldfish review, his yes before build. Any S1; or S2 in a risky family
             (privacy, personal data, delete/restore, sign-in, billing, paid limits, payments, roles, consent).
  standard - design note + one fresh review. Other S2; a large fix; S3 in a risky family.
  light    - batched: tests where behaviour changes, one fresh review per batch.
A family with a finding that needs his call is listed under "his calls" too; its build waits only for that answer.

Batches: light and standard families of the same master family and main surface, up to BATCH_MAX findings.
Waves: batches whose files do not overlap, so up to WAVE_WIDTH helpers can run at once without touching
the same files. Order: the member app first (phone, watch), then server, web, panel, HQ.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: New data flows, outside companies and stored items ship without anyone updating the privacy notice or terms, because there is no list of where data goes that is checked against the notice.
full.guard: Keep one data-flow register (every outside company, stored item and keep-for time); a check fails when code sends data to a host or keeps a table not in the register, and every register change needs a notice update in both languages plus an in-app notice-changed prompt.

full.cause: Releases are recorded as shipped without checking that the store actually published them, so fixes and notes reach members late or not at all.
full.guard: A post-release check that reads the store track's live version and fails the release run if it does not match.

full.cause: The under-18 stop only blocks new saving; it does not remove what is already stored or update the status line.
full.guard: The under-18 stop runs one shared routine that deletes server copies and updates every status, with a test.

full.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
full.cause: Test gyms are made on the live server and recognised by their name, so a real gym with a 'QA' name can be deleted and old-brand test gyms are visible.
full.guard: Mark test gyms with a flag at creation and delete only flagged ones; keep test data off the live server.

full.cause: A typed mobile number is trusted as a person's identity with no proof it is theirs and no way to change it, so recycled numbers, strangers and look-alike names can take over sign-in, messages and enquiries.
full.guard: Every place that uses a mobile number as identity requires a proven number (WhatsApp check) and offers a change-number step, with a test that a number in two gyms or re-assigned cannot open the other.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: Privacy sentences on screens and websites ('never sent', 'not kept', 'we never message you', 'only on this phone') are typed once by hand and not worked out from the real sharing switches and stored copies.
full.guard: Build every privacy sentence from the sharing switches and the data-flow register, with a test per sentence that flips each switch and checks the words still hold.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: The privacy notice and on-screen data promises are typed by hand instead of being built from the list of what is actually sent, stored or shared, so they understate what leaves the phone.
full.guard: Keep one list of every data field sent off the device and who sees it, and a check that the privacy notice and each 'stays on this phone / only the gym sees' line agree with it.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: Privacy and legal words were written without checking where data really goes (backups, uploads, payment store), so they promise more than is true.
full.guard: A data-flow list that every privacy sentence is checked against before release.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: Privacy promises (what stays on the phone, what the gym, desk or AI never sees) are written in words but no shared test watches what actually leaves or shows.
full.guard: A shared privacy harness that records every outgoing request, file and screen per role, and one assertion per written promise.

full.cause: People are matched by names, first words or per-sign-in accounts instead of one stable key, so the same person becomes two records or loses data.
full.guard: One shared person-matching rule (normalised mobile, then account link) used by every join, import, lead and chat path.

full.cause: Consent, opt-outs and age are not recorded: joining keeps no notice or 18+ record, age is a fixed number, minors can be added, default sharing has no lawful basis and members cannot opt out of offers.
full.guard: Store consent with version, date and birth year at every join and sharing switch, plus a no-offers mark, with a test that each outward send checks it.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: There is no single list of every place a person's or gym's data lives, so erase, sign-out, leave and delete are never checked to clear all of them.
full.guard: A data inventory (every table, store, file, shortcut, widget, reminder) and one removal test that checks each place is empty after erase, sign-out, leave or delete.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Backups, exports and cloud copies each list by hand which kinds of data they include, so new tables, files, columns and photos are left out.
full.guard: Build each copy's scope from the schema and storage list, and a test that fails when a table, column or file store is in no copy.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Restore, replace and undo on the phone act only on the phone's workouts, unaware of the background cloud copy and of other record types, so undone data returns and counts are wrong.
full.guard: Restore and undo go through one step that pauses or updates the cloud copy and counts every record type, with a test for a signed-in member.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Backup and bring-back are tested as separate words and steps, never as one round trip, so restore screens, Drive cards, repacked files and failed or half-saved backups go unchecked.
full.guard: One backup-then-restore round-trip test per surface (phone file, Drive, account copy, panel download) including a half-saved file and a failure part-way.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: The photo backup switch was moved out of reach, so members cannot turn it off.
full.guard: Every on switch for sharing or backup must have a reachable off switch, checked by a settings test.

full.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
full.cause: Whether a member owns MettleUp Plus, its plan type, free month and staff unlock live only on the phone, with no server record checked with Google Play, so purchases are missed, double-charged, kept after they end or guessed.
full.guard: Before Plus goes live, verify every purchase and staff unlock on the server with Google Play and keep the entitlement there; the phone only reads it, with a test for pending, refunded, cancelled and reinstall cases.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Deleting a gym, a member leaving and Erase each list by hand what to remove, so new stores are missed, some are kept too long and proof that must stay is deleted.
full.guard: One retention table (what is deleted, kept or emptied, and when) that every delete path reads, with a test that a deleted gym, leaver and erase leave nothing outside the table.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Keep-for limits promised in the notice are left to chance: some deletes only run when someone opens a screen and many tables have no clean-up at all, because no nightly job owns every stated limit.
full.guard: One nightly clean-up job driven by a keep-for table that lists every personal-data table with its limit; a test fails when a table holding names, numbers or photos has no row in it.

full.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
full.cause: Rate limits and AI caps are one shared bucket per day, gym or whole product with no per-caller limit (and the real caller address is lost behind our server), and some endpoints answer anyone, so one outsider can use them up or get free AI.
full.guard: Every public endpoint must have a per-caller limit before any shared ceiling, read the real caller address, and require a gym or member key for AI answers; a check lists every endpoint with its limits and an alert on spikes.

full.cause: The gym's MettleUp plan state (waiting payment, plan switch, end reminder, open pay links) is decided in several places tied to online checkout, so UPI-paying gyms are treated wrongly.
full.guard: One billing state machine on the server that all reminders and plan changes read, with tests for UPI, waiting and switch cases.

full.cause: Emergency access to a gym's records was built without matching the owner-facing promise or telling the owner, so the words promise consent that the button does not need.
full.guard: One rule for emergency access (words, consent and an owner notice each time it opens) with a test that opening it writes the owner notice.

full.cause: The data agreement promises every look at a gym's records is recorded and shown, but direct database reads, master-key reads and reads past a cap are not recorded and the record keeps raw query text.
full.guard: Every read path to gym data writes to one access log (no cap, query values blanked) that the access card reads, with a test per read path.

full.master_title: Privacy promises vs real data flows
full.cause: Website, store listing and join-page claims about product behaviour are written by hand and not re-checked when a feature changes or is retired (Drive backup, messages, renew, reminders, switching offer).
full.guard: A claims register: each public claim links to the feature switch or test it depends on, and a check fails when that feature changes without the claim being re-approved.

full.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
full.cause: AI credit rules (what costs a credit, starter credits, monthly free numbers, pack prices) are typed by hand into the website, help, HQ and credits sheet instead of read from one price table.
full.guard: One credit-rules table that the server, credits sheet, HQ and website copy read from, with a test that every credit sentence matches it.

full.cause: Hiding names and numbers before sending to the AI is done separately in each call, so rewrites and some import columns send real details, and public lines claim the AI sees columns only.
full.guard: One send-to-AI step that masks personal data for every call, with a test that no phone, email or name reaches any AI request, and public claims worded from it.

full.cause: Facts are read from free-text names (plan names, friend names, exercise names) instead of fixed ids.
full.guard: Match by id from fixed lists; a lint flags name-word matching for business rules.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: There is no single list of every table and file that holds a person's or gym's data, so member erase, member delete and gym delete each forget some copies (photos, measurements, AI history, enquiries, shop copy, second database) or delete records that must stay.
full.guard: One server-side data inventory that every erase and delete path walks, with a test that seeds one row in every personal-data table and storage folder and asserts erase leaves none (and tax records stay).

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Copies of gym data kept on staff browsers and phones (set-aside copy, outbox, offline member list) have no end date and are not wiped when the person is removed or signs out.
full.guard: Every on-device copy carries a last-server-contact date and owner; the app refuses to open it after a set age, removal or sign-out, and deletes it once uploaded.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: The nightly backup is not sized for growth, misses some tables and has never been restored for real.
full.guard: A scheduled real restore drill that checks every table and reports backup size against the store limit.

full.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
full.cause: Excel import does not record what it changed in existing members (prices, filled details, app links, measurements), so undo removes or keeps the wrong things.
full.guard: Import keeps a full before-and-after record per member it touches and undo replays it, with a test on a gym that already has members.

full.cause: Whether a payment link or fee ask is open, paid online, expired, cancelled or failed is not one record every screen reads, so desk, shop, enquiry and member screens guess and show pay buttons, old UPI IDs or 'not paid' for money already taken.
full.guard: Keep one payment-request status on the server that every desk and member screen reads (and re-reads on return), with a test for each status across the enquiry, shop, receipt and member screens.

full.cause: The money records have no refunded or reversed state, so cancelling an online-paid receipt or order, a double payment, an over-payment or a wrongly confirmed payment leaves no way to record that money went back.
full.guard: Add a refunded/reversed state to the payments ledger; every cancel or void path must check for an online payment and set it, guarded by a test per cancel path.

full.cause: Whether a payment is test or live is not carried with each payment, so test payments create real plans, receipts, member alerts and 'Paid' lines, and help and HQ treat test as real.
full.guard: Store test-or-live on every payment and request and pass it to every plan, receipt, alert and screen; a test makes one test-mode payment and checks no surface treats it as real.

full.cause: Cash taken on a desk without internet that the server later refuses (or never receives) has no proper state, so it vanishes from dues and counts, leaves receipt gaps or sits on a removed device unseen.
full.guard: Give refused or unsent offline money its own visible state on the server and the member page, and warn before removing a device or going read-only while any is held.

full.cause: The assistant's add-member card does not recompute the joining fee when the plan changes.
full.guard: A test that changing the plan on the card recomputes every fee.

full.cause: A gym's plan, trial, branch and paid-until state is changed by many separate HQ and payment actions, each with its own logic, so hand plans, trials, branches, founding places and upgrades contradict each other and the promises.
full.guard: Route every change to a gym's plan through one server function that enforces the plan rules (trial length, branch price, founding count, planned switches, paid-until in the future), with a table-driven test of every HQ action.

full.cause: Member and gym status changes (leave, return, lapse, archive, pause, gym leaving) are not one state machine, so each feature handles them its own way and members stay archived, duplicate, lose marks or stay on machines and web pages.
full.guard: One member and gym lifecycle state machine on the server that every feature subscribes to, plus a cross-role test that walks leave, return, lapse and pause through every feature.

full.cause: Disconnecting the shop does not close it on the server.
full.guard: Close the shop server-side on disconnect, with a test that blocks new orders.

full.cause: Personal training packs are stored as membership plans and not linked to trainers, so plan readers count them and trainers never hear of them.
full.guard: Give PT packs their own type, excluded by the shared plan reader and linked to the trainer, with a test.

full.cause: Import reads a plan's length from the first number in its name.
full.guard: Parse length only from length words, with a fixture set of real plan names.

full.cause: 'Stopped coming' counting ignores freezes, approved pauses, closed days and a new plan start, and is written by more than one rule.
full.guard: One shared absence rule that subtracts pauses and closed days and restarts at a new plan, used everywhere, with tests.

full.cause: The server accepts role-limited actions and values (pass member, every-branch, door dates, offline flag, back-dated check-ins, option prices) exactly as the admin app sends them, so desk limits exist only on screen.
full.guard: Check role and value for every write on the server (desk vs owner, dates from saved plans, prices from the catalogue), with a test that calls each write with a desk key and odd values.

full.cause: Screens ship before the server part they call exists live, so a missing server piece reads as 'switched off' or a feature that does nothing.
full.guard: A deploy check that every server function and table a screen calls exists on the live database before the screen can be switched on.

full.cause: Pass visits do not store the pass company at check-in, so history is read from the member's current pass.
full.guard: Write the company on the visit row, with a test that edits the member afterwards.

full.cause: Personal data (names, ID numbers, typed numbers) is put into outgoing AI requests, download files or browser storage with no shared filter that strips it.
full.guard: One shared filter for every outgoing request, export file and browser store, plus a test that searches each for names, mobiles and ID numbers.

groups.guard: A store-policy release gate that checks target version, permissions, update path and open Play Console tasks before any upload.

groups.guard: Release notes older than the last few versions are hidden or frozen with a note, and a check flags page names in notes that no longer exist.

groups.cause: Fixes are announced in What's new before they are proven on the phone that had the problem.
groups.guard: A release rule: a What's new line about a device fix needs a recorded real-device test on that device.

groups.cause: The release checks prove only one path (last release, stock emulator, GitHub copy, phone without watch, one deploy order), so other real update and release paths ship unproven.
groups.guard: A release-path matrix (older release, Play copy, watch, paired watch, OEM phone, deploy order, version bumps) that the release run must pass.

groups.cause: What's new notes are written by hand with no check against the real behaviour or the app they ship in, so they can say the reverse of what happens or repeat the phone's notes for the watch.
groups.guard: Tag each What's new line with its app and the feature it describes, and review it against that feature before upload.

groups.cause: The release and CI workflows' safety stops are written as workflow text with no self-test run on every push.
groups.guard: Self-tests for every workflow guard (failed, cancelled, skip switch, live key, dry run) run on every push.

groups.cause: Sends are marked done when they are handed over, not when they really succeed, so failures are never retried and screens say 'sent' too early.
groups.guard: A shared outbox rule: a send is marked done only on confirmed success, failed sends stay queued for retry, and screens show 'queued' until then; one test fails the provider and checks the retry.

groups.cause: CI checks can show green while testing nothing (skipped, warn-only, re-run, never triggered).
groups.guard: Every CI check must report how many things it tested and fail on zero, with no warn-only check left past a set date.

groups.cause: Cloud run setup is copied by hand into each run, so fixes and versions drift.
groups.guard: One shared setup step that every run uses.

groups.cause: Server change files say by hand whether they are live, and nobody updates them after they are applied.
groups.guard: Generate the applied/not-applied line from the live list of applied changes, checked in CI.

groups.cause: Database change files are not safe to run again and the live state is not checked against them, so re-running an old step undoes later ones.
groups.guard: A cloud check that runs every step twice in order and compares live functions with the newest file after each change.

groups.cause: A test message was left live in every gym's bell.
groups.guard: Test sends go to a test gym only, enforced by HQ.

groups.cause: What's new dates are stored without a year, so new-feature dots come back a year later.
groups.guard: Every stored date carries its year; a test checks an old note never shows a dot.

groups.cause: A typed mobile number is trusted as a person's identity with no proof it is theirs and no way to change it, so recycled numbers, strangers and look-alike names can take over sign-in, messages and enquiries.
groups.guard: Every place that uses a mobile number as identity requires a proven number (WhatsApp check) and offers a change-number step, with a test that a number in two gyms or re-assigned cannot open the other.

groups.cause: Sign-ins and keys (panel, device, HQ, shop key, phone session) have no expiry and cannot be ended from the server, and the phone session sits in backed-up storage.
groups.guard: Every session and key carries a server-side version and last-seen date; the server refuses idle or revoked ones, with a test per sign-in type.

groups.cause: A gym's join code is the only thing needed to join its member app, yet it is shown on the public page and has no wrong-try limit.
groups.guard: Give the public page its own join-form code and count wrong codes per caller, with a test for guessing and page-code use.

groups.cause: PIN set, change and sign-in each carry their own rules and words, so a saved PIN can be followed by a wrong error and a change lock does not grow.
groups.guard: One PIN rule module (lock growth, current-PIN ask, saved-then-sign-in) used by every PIN path, with tests.

groups.cause: People are matched by names, first words or per-sign-in accounts instead of one stable key, so the same person becomes two records or loses data.
groups.guard: One shared person-matching rule (normalised mobile, then account link) used by every join, import, lead and chat path.

groups.guard: Match by id from fixed lists; a lint flags name-word matching for business rules.

groups.cause: The alerts key request to HQ has no time limit, so a slow HQ hangs it.
groups.guard: Every server-to-server call has a time limit, checked by a lint and a slow-answer test.

groups.cause: The gym sync sign-in card has no forgotten-password path.
groups.guard: Add a reset link before the card is switched on.

groups.cause: A background check forces sign-in when the session ends and throws away what was being typed.
groups.guard: Session expiry keeps unsaved input and asks to sign in over the page.

groups.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
groups.cause: Demo workouts are not flagged in one place, so widgets, exports and counts treat them as real.
groups.guard: Every reader filters through one 'real workouts only' helper, with a test that loads the demo.

groups.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
groups.cause: The demo gym re-implements real gym rules in its own fake layer, so its counts, limits and approvals drift from the real gym.
groups.guard: Run the demo through the real rule functions, with a test that demo and real give the same result for the same action.

groups.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
groups.cause: The sales demo's pretend server is never exercised by pressing buttons, so its acted-out actions, refusals, badges and reset are unchecked.
groups.guard: A demo walk test that presses every acted-out action and one refused action per page and compares badges with cards.

groups.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
groups.cause: One-time repairs and import markers depend on reads that can fail and leave no trace, so repairs rerun, fail silently or delay start-up.
groups.guard: A shared one-time-job runner that records success durably, logs failure, never blocks start-up, and is tested by failing the marker read.

groups.master_title: Test and demo data on the live system
groups.cause: New rules apply only to new records, with no backfill for existing members or data.
groups.guard: Every rule change ships with a backfill step and a check that old records meet the new rule.

groups.cause: The under-18 stop only blocks new saving; it does not remove what is already stored or update the status line.
groups.guard: The under-18 stop runs one shared routine that deletes server copies and updates every status, with a test.

groups.cause: Consent, opt-outs and age are not recorded: joining keeps no notice or 18+ record, age is a fixed number, minors can be added, default sharing has no lawful basis and members cannot opt out of offers.
groups.guard: Store consent with version, date and birth year at every join and sharing switch, plus a no-offers mark, with a test that each outward send checks it.

groups.cause: Terms acceptance is captured only once at join, never re-asked on change, not re-openable and not read by HQ.
groups.guard: A terms version number checked on every sign-in, re-openable from settings and shown in HQ.

groups.cause: The admin panel and HQ have logic tests but no rule that every page, sheet, card and button is opened and pressed in a browser test, so whole screens are never driven.
groups.guard: A browser-test coverage check that lists every panel and HQ route, sheet, card and button and fails CI when no test opens or presses it.

groups.cause: Screen and server tests sign in as the owner only; there is no shared way to replay them as front desk, trainer, staff, demo or a member who left, so other roles are never checked.
groups.guard: A role matrix runner that replays each screen and server test as owner, desk, trainer and demo, with the expected view per role written once.

groups.cause: Some tests pass while the feature is broken: they read the code's text, test a helper no screen uses, take a picture without checking it, make a check optional, run where the page is replaced, feed no data, or accept any count.
groups.guard: Each new or changed test must be shown failing once against a broken feature (break-it check), and source-text and optional assertions are banned by a lint.

groups.cause: Tests run at one fixed moment, so expiry windows, day limits, midnight in India, keep times and 'after N days' rules are never exercised.
groups.guard: A shared fake clock that every timed rule test moves past its edge (minutes, days, midnight IST).

groups.cause: The phone app's rules are tested as data but there is no rule that every screen, sheet, card and button is opened and pressed in a device test, so whole screens are never driven.
groups.guard: A device-test coverage check that lists every phone screen, sheet, card and button and fails CI when no flow opens or presses it.

groups.cause: Form checks and refusal words on phone, panel and web forms are scattered per screen, so tests type only good values.
groups.guard: Each form's checks come from one shared validation table that its screen test walks, entering every bad value and reading the refusal words.

groups.cause: Phone tests never make a save, read or server call fail, so failed saves, load errors, empty pages and no-internet states are never seen.
groups.guard: A shared fault switch on the phone's database and network layer (fail, offline, slow, empty) and a rule that every screen flow covers those states.

groups.cause: The written journeys and the tests are kept separately and nothing ties a test's expectation to an agreed rule, so they contradict each other and some tests lock in behaviour nobody decided on.
groups.guard: Every test that asserts a rule cites its journey line, and a check fails when a journey line and its test expect different things.

groups.cause: Panel tests use a fake server that always answers, so failed saves, no internet, empty lists, loading and not-online states are never seen.
groups.guard: A shared fake server with fail, offline, slow and empty switches, and a rule that every panel screen test covers those four states.

groups.cause: Error, refusal and hint words live as strings no test reads, so the exact words members and staff see are never checked.
groups.guard: A words coverage check: every user-facing message string must be asserted by at least one test.

groups.cause: Alerts, bell lines, pop-ups and phone notifications are built in many places with no shared test of who gets them, what they say, where they open and when they stay quiet.
groups.guard: One alert matrix test: for each alert type, each role, its words, its page, its lock-screen content and its quiet cases.

groups.cause: Tests always say yes and go forward; Cancel, Back, Not now and backing out are never pressed.
groups.guard: Every sheet and step test must also press Cancel or Back and check nothing changed.

groups.cause: Server functions' refusals and edge cases are never listed, so database tests cover only the accepted case.
groups.guard: Each server function lists its refusals in one table, and a check fails when a refusal has no test of both the refusal words and that nothing was written.

groups.cause: Server functions and HQ routes are added without a rule that each has a database or route test, so whole calls, lists and saves are never exercised on the server.
groups.guard: A coverage check that lists every database function and server route and fails when no server test calls it and reads the result back.

groups.cause: Nothing simulates the app being closed, restarted, updated, reloaded or restored part-way, so recovery paths are never run.
groups.guard: A restart harness that kills and reopens the app (or reloads the page) at each saved step and checks the state comes back.

groups.cause: The watch app has almost no screen or service tests, so its buttons, taps, phone hand-off and sensors are never driven.
groups.guard: A watch test harness (fake phone channel, fake sensors) and a coverage check over watch screens and buttons.

groups.cause: Phone and watch notifications and reminders are posted from several services and no test posts one and reads back its words, lock-screen content, channel, tap route or schedule change.
groups.guard: A notification test harness that posts each phone and watch notification and checks words, lock-screen visibility, sound, tap route, and reminder re-scheduling.

groups.cause: Test gyms have one branch, so anything that changes with two or more branches (tiles, imports, timings, PINs, visitors) is never tried.
groups.guard: A standard two-branch test gym used by every screen and server test suite.

groups.cause: Save, start and share buttons each handle busy state on their own and no test ever presses them twice.
groups.guard: One shared busy-button component for every save, start and share, plus a sweep test that double-taps each one.

groups.cause: Settings are read once at start and no test flips them on and off (or while a screen is open) and checks the effect.
groups.guard: Each setting gets a test that flips it both ways, including while the affected screen is open, and checks the effect.

groups.cause: Nightly clean-ups, scheduled runs and automatic starts are tested, if at all, on one row and only when every step works.
groups.guard: Each scheduled job gets a test that plants old and edge rows of every kind it touches and makes one early step fail.

groups.cause: The public gym-server addresses and relay pass-through are tested only for their main page, not headers, unknown addresses or upgrades.
groups.guard: An address test that sends each public address an unknown path, a live-update upgrade and checks the safety headers.

groups.cause: Many screens and services have no test that runs them, only tests that look for words in the code, so breakage goes unseen.
groups.guard: A coverage gate that each screen and service has at least one test that renders or runs it, and a ban on source-text tests.

groups.cause: Tests start from an empty database and a single fresh path, never from last version's data, re-runs, passing time or every payment company.
groups.guard: CI loads a saved demo gym from the previous version, re-runs every change, walks time forward and covers every payment company.

groups.cause: The rule that hides a note line repeating the workout name, meant for imported workouts, runs on every workout and hides the member's own first line.
groups.guard: The hide rule is limited to imported workouts and tested on a typed note.

groups.cause: Failures are caught and either shown as 'try again' or kept only on the device, with no shared reporter that writes a log line and sends it to MettleUp, so breakage is invisible until a gym complains.
groups.guard: One shared report-failure helper (log line plus send to the HQ error view) and a lint rule that fails the build on any catch block that does not call it.

groups.cause: When a read fails, the code falls back to a default (empty, zero, none, all clear, paid, not demo) that looks like a true answer, so screens and decisions act on a guess.
groups.guard: Reads return an explicit 'could not read' state every caller must handle; a lint rule bans catch blocks that return an empty or default value, plus a test per reader that forces the failure.

groups.cause: An action fails and the user is shown nothing, or is told it worked, because the failure path has no message.
groups.guard: Every user action's failure path must show a message; a shared action wrapper does this and a test forces each action to fail.

groups.cause: A failed read or call is drawn as an ordinary state (empty, not found, offline, switched off, nothing to do) because screens have no shared loading/failed/empty helper that keeps failure separate.
groups.guard: One shared load-state helper with a distinct 'could not load, try again' state, plus a check that every data read on a screen handles the failed state.

groups.cause: Failures the apps catch themselves (saves, imports, sign-in, native alerts, watch crashes) are shown calmly but never reach MettleUp, because the crash report path is used only for uncaught crashes.
groups.guard: Every caught failure on a key task calls one shared report helper (no personal data, rate-limited), checked by a test that fails when a catch on a key task does not report.

groups.cause: A save or action that fails is caught and dropped with no word to the person, because each screen handles its own errors instead of going through one shared save helper that shows the failure.
groups.guard: Route every user-started save through the shared save helper that always shows a calm failure line, and a lint rule that bans empty catch blocks on user actions.

groups.cause: Screens pick their error words from one catch-all guess instead of the real kind of failure, so a server fault, a shared limit or a full store is shown as 'no internet', 'switched off', 'you used too much' or a vague error.
groups.guard: One shared error classifier (offline / server fault / shared limit / full store / refused with reason) that every screen uses for its message, with a test feeding each kind.

groups.cause: Crash reporting covers only the JavaScript side and sends only when online, and its alert ignores repeats, so native and offline crashes are missed.
groups.guard: Native crashes are queued offline and sent later, with an alert on returning or spreading crash kinds, checked by a forced test crash in CI.

groups.cause: One fixed message is used for several real situations (saved vs handed over, PIN vs code, preview vs saved, which folder), because the screen does not pick its words from the actual result.
groups.guard: Messages after an action are chosen from the action's real result object, with a test per result branch.

groups.cause: Save handlers return early at the free limit without clearing their busy state, so Save keeps spinning.
groups.guard: Clear busy state in a finally block in the shared save helper.

groups.cause: Rules trim, cut or leave out what a person typed or chose without saying so, and tests lock that silence in.
groups.guard: No rule may drop or cut input without a visible line; a shared check flags any trim or filter that has no message.

groups.cause: The anti-robot box value is not passed on in one of the PIN reset paths.
groups.guard: Pass the value on every send, with a test for each path.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Automatic jobs, senders and outside services (WhatsApp, AI, payment keys, backup) have no heartbeat the outage alarm checks, and some health checks answer 'fine' when they cannot read, so a stopped job goes unnoticed.
groups.guard: Every job and outside service writes a heartbeat; the outage alarm runs on time, checks each heartbeat and fails loud on unreadable state, with a test that stops each one.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Nightly jobs, keys, outside services and devices can stop working with only a hidden log line, because nothing records each part's last good run where HQ's health check reads it.
groups.guard: Each job, key and outside dependency writes a last-good-run record that HQ's health page reads, with an alert when a record is older than its window.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Free-tier and paid limits have no early warning to MettleUp, so the first sign is a failure.
groups.guard: One limits table watched daily with an HQ Needs-you alarm at 70 percent of each limit.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: No product usage events are recorded anywhere central, so activation, day-30 use and feature uptake are unknown and some progress lives only in one browser.
groups.guard: One shared usage-event helper writing to the server, with a required event list per feature that a check compares against the code.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Screens poll on fixed short timers with no back-off or stop, and static files go through the worker, using up the shared free request limit.
groups.guard: A shared poll helper that backs off and stops when idle or hidden, and a request budget per screen measured in CI.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Server data grows with no per-gym size budget and no scheduled cleanup, so one gym or old data can fill the free database or store.
groups.guard: A per-gym storage budget and a nightly cleanup job for each growing table, with a size check in CI.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Browser and phone stores have no size budget or early warning, so a full device silently drops data.
groups.guard: One device-storage budget helper that warns early and never drops queued records without telling the user.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Public or anonymous paths have no per-caller or total cap, or their cap switches off quietly when its store fails.
groups.guard: Every public path has a rate and total cap that fails closed, with a test per path.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Pages ship as one big download with blocking fonts and late pictures, and nothing checks page speed on a phone.
groups.guard: A page-speed check on a phone profile in CI with a size and layout-shift budget.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: The pop-up sender sends a fixed number per minute, so big gyms wait and late pop-ups are dropped.
groups.guard: Size the sender by queue length and alarm on late or dropped pop-ups.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Screens hold the processor or screen awake and redraw too often, and battery use is never measured.
groups.guard: A battery and redraw budget measured in the watch and phone workout tests.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Database links and filters have no index and the database check never asks for index advice, so reads scan whole tables.
groups.guard: Add the database index advisor to the database check and fail on any unindexed link or filter.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Screens and saves recompute from the whole history on every open, tick or save instead of keeping running totals, and nothing times this against big data.
groups.guard: A big-gym and five-year-member speed test in CI with a time budget per screen.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Bulk work and page loads send requests one after another instead of in one batch.
groups.guard: A shared batch-write helper and a test that a bulk action makes one request.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Outside calls are made with no time limit, so a stalled line leaves screens waiting for ever.
groups.guard: One shared fetch helper with a default time limit, and a lint rule banning bare fetch calls.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Cloud build runs pull outside code by moving versions, paste typed inputs into commands, have unlimited access passes and print account details to public logs.
groups.guard: A workflow lint in CI: pinned actions, read-only default permissions, inputs via env and quoted, and no secret fields printed.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Nothing checks the apps' libraries for known security holes, so flagged spreadsheet, navigation, sharing and watch libraries ship.
groups.guard: Turn on dependency alerts and a release check that fails on known high-rated flaws in phone, watch and panel libraries.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: The app's update check and update notes read GitHub, not the store the member installed from.
groups.guard: Update checks read the store the app came from.

groups.master_title: Jobs, services, storage and load unwatched
groups.cause: Long lists draw every row and pictures are drawn full size, with no virtualising or small previews.
groups.guard: Shared list and picture parts that virtualise rows and use thumbnails, required by lint.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Screen and help words are written once and not re-checked when the feature changes, so they promise or name things that are not true.
groups.guard: Each promise sentence is tied to a behaviour test, and help and what's-new pages are checked against live switches before release.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Screen words are written as fixed promises instead of being driven by the real state, so they claim things that are not true (saved, safe, a button that does not exist, a fixed 15 minutes).
groups.guard: Any line that states a fact (saved, safe, wait N minutes, works in pounds) must be fed by the state it describes, with a test of the failing state.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Help articles are written by hand apart from the screens and the help check covers only some folders, so help lags, contradicts or skips live features.
groups.guard: The help check walks every screen, sheet and component folder and fails when a live feature has no help answer or an answer names a removed or changed part.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Help articles quote buttons and questions by hand and nothing checks them against the screens.
groups.guard: A test that finds every quoted label in the help articles in the app code.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Internal names (database step numbers, 'old owner key', 'gym server', system prefixes, the old brand kind) reach people, because raw stored values and code words go straight into text with no plain-words layer.
groups.guard: A words check that fails on a list of internal terms in any user text, and a rule that stored codes are mapped to plain words before display.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Screen text is typed in each screen instead of one shared word list, so the same thing has two, three or four names across screens and apps.
groups.guard: One shared glossary that screens pull their nouns from, and a words check that flags banned synonyms.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: House style rules (never 'OK', sentence case, plain true lines) are known but not enforced, so individual lines slip through clumsy or untrue.
groups.guard: Run the words check (banned words, casing, plain-English review) over every user-facing string in CI.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Screens and messages name menus, tabs and buttons by hand ('in Profile', 'tap Back up now'), so the words go stale when a screen or button moves or changes.
groups.guard: Name places through one shared table of menu paths and button labels, and a check that fails when text names a label that no longer exists.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Hinglish covers only the screens whose words were wrapped in the language lookup, and nothing fails when a new line is left unwrapped or a Hinglish line is wrong.
groups.guard: A check that fails on any user-facing string not passed through the language lookup, plus a read-aloud review of new Hinglish lines.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Counts are glued to a fixed plural word ('1 days', '1 members'), because there is no shared plural helper.
groups.guard: One shared count-and-noun helper used for every count, plus a test of the 1 and 0 cases.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Each screen writes its own 'contact MettleUp / tell your gym' line, often with no number, link or fallback, because there is no shared support-contact component.
groups.guard: One shared Get help / contact MettleUp component used on every error, dead end and support line, with a check that bans bare 'message MettleUp' text.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: The card draws its heading only once the member app is on.
groups.guard: Draw the heading in every card state, with a picture test.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Greyed-out controls show no reason, because there is no shared disabled-with-reason control.
groups.guard: A shared disabled control that requires a reason line, and a lint rule against bare disabled buttons.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: The routine rest picker uses a fixed default instead of the saved one.
groups.guard: Pass the saved default, with a test.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: The welcome message to a new owner has no admin app address.
groups.guard: Add the address from config to the template.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: AI that writes offers or answers visitors is not told what it must not promise (body results, things the gym never wrote).
groups.guard: Shared writing rules banning health, result and unwritten promises in every customer-facing AI prompt, plus a rule-breaking test before switch-on.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: Leads from the member app are sent once, thinly and unlabelled, because the lead path was built without retry, detail or a source label.
groups.guard: One lead record with source, contact and retry, shown in HQ's daily work.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: The owner site offers in-person setup with no area limit.
groups.guard: State the visit area on the site.

groups.master_title: Screen words, help and 'say it once'
groups.cause: The booking sheet opens on the shown week even when it is over.
groups.guard: Default the sheet to today when the week is past.

groups.cause: There is no single rule for whether a member can get an app pop-up, so send screens say 'sent' or 'members see it' without checking who will really get it.
groups.guard: One shared 'can this member be reached, and how' rule used by every send screen, which lists who will not get it and offers WhatsApp instead.

groups.cause: Writes carry no once-only request id and taps are not guarded, so a retry after a lost answer, or a double tap, saves twice or is misread as a new or bad request.
groups.guard: Every write sends a once-only request id that the server stores and replays, and a shared test retries each write after a dropped answer.

groups.cause: Sends keep no per-member delivery or seen record, so owners, HQ and MettleUp cannot see who got or read a message.
groups.guard: A per-member delivery record written by every sender and shown on each send screen, with a test that a send leaves one.

groups.cause: Events that need someone to act (a booking change, a payment decision, an unanswered question, a waiting join, a stopped copy) have no alert, because alerts are added by hand per event with no list of who must know.
groups.guard: One table of events and who must be told, checked by a test that each event in the table sends its alert.

groups.cause: Shown notifications and pop-ups have no 'close when the thing is done or changed' step, so stale notices stay or keep coming after the job, renewal, switch-off or erase.
groups.guard: Every alert kind declares the event that clears it, and a test checks each clear event removes the notice on phone, browser and watch.

groups.cause: Each alert sets its own sound, vibration, channel importance and watch buzz, so OEM silencing, silent mode and the watch are handled for some alerts and not others.
groups.guard: One shared alert helper that applies channel importance, silent-mode, rescue ring and watch buzz to every alert, tested on an OEM phone and a paired watch.

groups.cause: There is no one rule that decides when a pop-up may ring (quiet hours, urgent kinds, the daily allowance, grouping edits), so each sender rings at any hour and in any amount.
groups.guard: One shared send policy (quiet hours, urgency, allowance, batching) that every member and gym alert goes through, with tests for night, urgent and over-allowance cases.

groups.cause: The open admin app and HQ ring and pop up through their own in-page code, which skips the alert settings, the device switch and the browser's delivery limits.
groups.guard: Route in-page rings through the same alert settings check as background alerts, with a test that each setting silences the open-tab path.

groups.cause: Undo bars and saved notes vanish on a fixed short timer, and one is hand-made, so screen reader users and slow readers miss them.
groups.guard: Use the shared undo/notice bar everywhere, with a longer or no timeout while a screen reader is on.

groups.cause: Pop-up sends assume success (the address is cleared, the summary claimed, the renewed address ignored) instead of confirming hand-over, so some pop-ups are lost.
groups.guard: Mark a pop-up delivered only after the push service accepts it, and retry the rest; tested with a failed and a renewed address.

groups.cause: Lines that promise a phone notification are written as always true, though delivery depends on the member's settings and the server path.
groups.guard: A words-check rule that any promise of a pop-up uses the shared 'if notifications are on' phrasing.

groups.cause: Notification channels and their words were set once and not updated as new kinds of pop-up were added to them.
groups.guard: A list of pop-up kinds mapped to channels and words, with a test that every sent kind has its own matching channel.

groups.cause: Ideas, nudges and cards do not read the shared record of what was already sent, automated or finished, so they offer the same action again.
groups.guard: Every nudge reads one shared 'already done or automated' record before it shows, with a test per nudge.

groups.cause: Read marks, badges and tray pop-ups are set by side signals (background counts, pushes) rather than by the member actually opening the item.
groups.guard: Opening an item is the one place that marks it read, clears its pop-up and updates the count, covered by one test.

groups.cause: Reminders and birthday wishes are assumed to reach the member's phone, with no check of Android's limits or whether the phone shows them.
groups.guard: Check delivery conditions on the phone (unused-app pause, phone-side setting) and word panel promises from what the phone reports.

groups.cause: New-question and message alerts compare counts instead of ids, so a question that arrives just after another is answered makes no sound.
groups.guard: Alerts track waiting items by their own id, with a swap test.

groups.cause: Pending items (requests, leads, prizes, stuck payments, questions) close only through their own button, so the same thing done another way leaves them open.
groups.guard: Pending items are closed by matching the underlying event (payment, member, gift, reply, signup), with a test doing each by the other route.

groups.cause: Reply pop-ups put the message words on the lock screen.
groups.guard: Leave private words out of pop-up bodies by rule in the send helper.

groups.cause: Full-screen pop-ups (phone update, watch update, free month) decide on their own when to show, so one hides or blocks another for good.
groups.guard: One shared pop-up queue that shows one at a time and keeps the rest waiting, tested with two due at once.

groups.cause: 'Not now', 'Skip' and close on cards and offers hide them for good without saying where to find them again.
groups.guard: A rule that every dismiss either comes back or says where the thing lives, applied in the shared card component.

groups.cause: Refreshes are throttled by a time window alone, so a real change (a pop-up tap, new workout days) waits out or is thrown away by the window.
groups.guard: Throttles skip only when the content is unchanged, and a push tap always forces a fresh read; tested with a change inside the window.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Help questions, team replies, alert sign-ups, quick buttons and the shop key are kept per browser or phone instead of per gym and person, so they leak to the next user or are lost on another device.
groups.guard: A rule that person or gym data is stored server-side under gym + person, with a check that flags localStorage use for anything but per-device conveniences.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Seen marks, ticks, language and notes are kept in one browser or phone instead of on the server, so other devices disagree.
groups.guard: Owner and member state lives on the server; a lint check bans local storage for anything but view conveniences.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Reminders and cards act on an old copy on the phone with no freshness check.
groups.guard: Every read of a local copy checks its age and refreshes before acting on it.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The watch keeps its own copies of phone settings and workout state with no sync rule, so switches and dedupe windows drift from the phone.
groups.guard: The watch reads settings and rest state from one synced record on every use, with a test changing each setting on the phone.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Edits and deletes on one side are not pushed to the copies held elsewhere (member app, gym mates, gym offer counts).
groups.guard: Every edit or delete fires one shared change event that updates all copies, with a test that deletes and checks each copy.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The phone-watch link rests on assumptions (one install signal, the newest row, a counter that only rises) that break in real use.
groups.guard: A shared watch-link contract: several-signal install check, send exact set at Done, accept counter restarts, with tests for each.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The watch keeps its own copy of set-entry rules (required weight, effort choices) instead of getting them from the phone.
groups.guard: The phone sends the set rules to the watch, with a shared rule test both apps run.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Door machine commands and uploads are fire-and-forget with no acknowledged queue, so failed or unreadable ones are lost and lapsed members can keep entry.
groups.guard: A door-machine queue where each command and upload is acknowledged, retried and shown to the owner when it fails, with a test that drops one.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The desk's offline queue does not handle final refusals, cancels with no answer, or weak lines, and buttons are not greyed offline.
groups.guard: One offline-queue state model (waiting, refused, cancelled) shown on every screen, with controls greyed when offline, and tests.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Phone, watch, older phones and the server talk without telling each other their versions, so a newer or older side silently loses data, buttons or the reason for a refusal.
groups.guard: A version handshake on every phone-watch-server message, with answers for unknown requests and a test with mixed versions.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: An admin or HQ tab left open keeps running the old version, because the page never checks for a new version.
groups.guard: The open page checks the live version on its minute tick and shows a Reload line, with a test against a bumped version.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Work the phone does in the background (closed-app set ticks, Health deletes, leave notes, ratings, late replies, record rebuilds) has no durable outbox, so one failure or a closed app loses it or delays it for hours.
groups.guard: One durable phone outbox with retry and back-off for every background write, plus a test that kills the app mid-send and checks it lands later.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Linking a member found by number or invite to the gym list happens once and is not retried, so the member waits for a QR check-in.
groups.guard: Linking runs as a retried job until confirmed, with a test that fails the first try.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Putting a gym online copies once and does not send entries saved during the copy.
groups.guard: Send anything newer after the last copy round, with a test.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Only the top branch list checks for unsent entries before switching.
groups.guard: Put the unsent check inside the single branch-switch function.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Pages read their data once and no test changes the data while they are open, so stale numbers after an add, delete or payment go unnoticed.
groups.guard: One shared 'data changed' signal that pages listen to, plus a test that adds and deletes while each page is open.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Some gym choices (set-up ticks, language) are kept in the browser, not with the gym on the server, so a new device or address loses them.
groups.guard: Keep every gym-level choice on the server, with a check that no gym setting is written only to browser storage.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Gym plan sync to the phone has no clear merge rule for deleted or edited folders, so trainer changes are lost or lead nowhere.
groups.guard: A written merge rule for gym plans (trainer change wins and brings back deleted folders) with tests for delete, edit and pop-up tap.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: A watch update prompt hides after Back and leaves no lasting sign.
groups.guard: Any dismissible update prompt leaves a lasting badge until done.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Timed work (receipts, rest alarms, hold countdowns, quiet installs) runs only while a screen is open or the app is in front, so time promises are not kept.
groups.guard: Timed work runs on a server schedule or an exact system alarm, never on an open screen, with a test that backgrounds the app before the time.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The nightly door update runs inside the admin app instead of on the server.
groups.guard: Run scheduled door updates on the server.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Whether someone is new is guessed from install or join dates, so long-time members get new-member treatment and new ones get upgrade notes.
groups.guard: One shared 'is this person new' rule based on account history, with tests for reinstall, phone change and fresh install.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The app reads only its own switches, not the phone's notification, channel, Do Not Disturb or battery settings, so it says alerts are on when the phone blocks them.
groups.guard: One shared 'can this phone ring' check reading permission, channel, DND and maker battery rules, used by every alert status row.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Saves have no request id, version check or single-step write, so double taps, dropped connections and two desks at once save twice or undo each other.
groups.guard: Every money and plan write carries a request id or last-seen version checked by the server in one step, with a double-send test per write.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Deletes and repairs that touch several tables run as separate steps, so a close mid-way leaves data half gone.
groups.guard: Wrap multi-table writes in one transaction, with a test that kills the write mid-way.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: Start-up recovery ignores a rest that ended seconds before.
groups.guard: Treat a just-ended rest as over at start-up.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The watch keeps the last heart rate when the sensor says off-wrist.
groups.guard: Clear the reading on off-wrist or unavailable.

groups.master_title: Sync between phone, watch, cloud and devices
groups.cause: The assistant history saves the AI's first suggestion instead of what the owner saved.
groups.guard: Save the saved draft with the task, with a test that edits are what history shows.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: There is no single list of every table and file that holds a person's or gym's data, so member erase, member delete and gym delete each forget some copies (photos, measurements, AI history, enquiries, shop copy, second database) or delete records that must stay.
groups.guard: One server-side data inventory that every erase and delete path walks, with a test that seeds one row in every personal-data table and storage folder and asserts erase leaves none (and tax records stay).

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Erase, demo load and photo delete on the phone wipe a hand-picked list of stores, so photo folders, settings, trial dates, backup copies and the watch copy remain, and failures are hidden.
groups.guard: One phone data inventory that erase walks (including watch and backup copies) and reports each step, with a test that every store is empty after erase.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: There is no single list of every place a person's or gym's data lives, so erase, sign-out, leave and delete are never checked to clear all of them.
groups.guard: A data inventory (every table, store, file, shortcut, widget, reminder) and one removal test that checks each place is empty after erase, sign-out, leave or delete.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Deleting a gym, a member leaving and Erase each list by hand what to remove, so new stores are missed, some are kept too long and proof that must stay is deleted.
groups.guard: One retention table (what is deleted, kept or emptied, and when) that every delete path reads, with a test that a deleted gym, leaver and erase leave nothing outside the table.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Backups, exports and cloud copies each list by hand which kinds of data they include, so new tables, files, columns and photos are left out.
groups.guard: Build each copy's scope from the schema and storage list, and a test that fails when a table, column or file store is in no copy.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Restore, erase and sign-in do not cover every piece of member state, so some choices survive or are lost.
groups.guard: One list of member state items that restore, erase and sign-in all use, with a test that round-trips each item.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Restore, replace and undo on the phone act only on the phone's workouts, unaware of the background cloud copy and of other record types, so undone data returns and counts are wrong.
groups.guard: Restore and undo go through one step that pauses or updates the cloud copy and counts every record type, with a test for a signed-in member.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Restoring a backup brings back members who deleted their account since it was taken, and nothing re-deletes them.
groups.guard: The restore guide and drill re-apply account deletions logged after the backup, with a test.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Copies of gym data kept on staff browsers and phones (set-aside copy, outbox, offline member list) have no end date and are not wiped when the person is removed or signs out.
groups.guard: Every on-device copy carries a last-server-contact date and owner; the app refuses to open it after a set age, removal or sign-out, and deletes it once uploaded.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Keep-for limits promised in the notice are left to chance: some deletes only run when someone opens a screen and many tables have no clean-up at all, because no nightly job owns every stated limit.
groups.guard: One nightly clean-up job driven by a keep-for table that lists every personal-data table with its limit; a test fails when a table holding names, numbers or photos has no row in it.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Backup and bring-back are tested as separate words and steps, never as one round trip, so restore screens, Drive cards, repacked files and failed or half-saved backups go unchecked.
groups.guard: One backup-then-restore round-trip test per surface (phone file, Drive, account copy, panel download) including a half-saved file and a failure part-way.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: The backup's own safety (one consistent moment, a separate place) is assumed rather than built and checked.
groups.guard: Back up from a single read-only snapshot into a second, separate account, with a restore drill that checks a payment and its receipt arrive together.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: The nightly backup is not sized for growth, misses some tables and has never been restored for real.
groups.guard: A scheduled real restore drill that checks every table and reports backup size against the store limit.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: The nightly backup is a full readable copy, including secrets and PIN fingerprints, with no separate key and no record of who looks at it.
groups.guard: Backups exclude secrets by a deny-list, are locked with their own key, and every restore or download is logged.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: The photo backup switch was moved out of reach, so members cannot turn it off.
groups.guard: Every on switch for sharing or backup must have a reachable off switch, checked by a settings test.

groups.master_title: Delete, erase, backup and restore scope
groups.cause: Excel import does not record what it changed in existing members (prices, filled details, app links, measurements), so undo removes or keeps the wrong things.
groups.guard: Import keeps a full before-and-after record per member it touches and undo replays it, with a test on a gym that already has members.

groups.cause: Each report, tile and summary defines its own count (visits vs members, archived included, fee vs total, GST, partial weeks, cancel time), so the same number differs between screens.
groups.guard: One shared definition per metric used by every report, HQ tile and AI summary, with a test that compares the same metric across screens.

groups.cause: The same number (active members, ending this week, kg lifted, week goal, batch count) is counted separately on each screen, file and summary, so the same words show different numbers.
groups.guard: One shared metric module that every screen, export and summary reads, with a test that the same input gives the same figure everywhere it is labelled the same.

groups.cause: The same number (counts, records, kg, weeks, money) is worked out by separate rules in different places, so screens disagree.
groups.guard: One shared function per shown number and a cloud test that checks the number is the same everywhere it appears.

groups.cause: Whether a plan has started, ended, been renewed or is still owed is worked out separately on each screen, so dues, renewals and endings disagree.
groups.guard: One shared membership-status helper used by every tile, list, reminder and sheet, with tests for unstarted, cancelled and later renewals.

groups.cause: Money and weights are rounded in many places with different rules instead of one formatter, so paise vanish and kilos and pounds drift between screens and the watch.
groups.guard: One money formatter and one weight formatter (convert first, round once, two decimals, paise shown) used everywhere, with a lint that fails on ad-hoc rounding.

groups.cause: Progress maths use fixed calendar windows and ignore the member's real training span (join date, partial weeks, long breaks, easy weeks).
groups.guard: One shared training-span helper that every target, report and average uses, tested with a new member and one back after six weeks off.

groups.cause: Offers, rewards and leaderboards count activity the server never verified (fixed-code check-ins, back-dated or imported workouts, made-up kg, reused codes, taken-back check-ins).
groups.guard: Rewards and boards count only server-verified activity and remember what each reward covered, with a test per reward that replays and back-dates.

groups.cause: The friend-reward already-given check is keyed on the friend's name, not the enquiry.
groups.guard: Key rewards on the enquiry id, with a test of two friends with the same name.

groups.cause: The weigh-in typo check compares against the weigh-in being replaced.
groups.guard: Exclude the same day's entry, with a test.

groups.cause: The Strength score can fall with no explanation of why.
groups.guard: Show the reason for every score change, with a test.

groups.cause: Muscles ready today names one workout but shows another's sets.
groups.guard: A test that the named workout and the shown sets match.

groups.cause: The body map lights the wrong shoulder heads for side raises.
groups.guard: A test table of exercise-to-muscle lighting.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Whether a member owns MettleUp Plus, its plan type, free month and staff unlock live only on the phone, with no server record checked with Google Play, so purchases are missed, double-charged, kept after they end or guessed.
groups.guard: Before Plus goes live, verify every purchase and staff unlock on the server with Google Play and keep the entitlement there; the phone only reads it, with a test for pending, refunded, cancelled and reinstall cases.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: AI credit rules (what costs a credit, starter credits, monthly free numbers, pack prices) are typed by hand into the website, help, HQ and credits sheet instead of read from one price table.
groups.guard: One credit-rules table that the server, credits sheet, HQ and website copy read from, with a test that every credit sentence matches it.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: How many AI credits a task costs and when they come back is decided by the app or web caller, not by the server's ledger, so credits can be skipped, under-counted, charged for held-back answers or lost.
groups.guard: The server works out every credit charge from the saved task and gives credits back itself (signed, retried), with a test for charge, hold-back and failed-task paths.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: MettleUp Plus is built but its launch rules (renewal and cancel words, refund rule, who counts as staff, gym cover versus free month) were never decided and written down.
groups.guard: A Plus switch-on checklist (renewal line, cancel link, refund page, staff definition, gym-cover rule) that must be ticked before the Plus switch can be turned on.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Plus limits are checked separately in each screen and entry point, so restore and chart ranges slip past and a mid-workout change is not passed on to the workout or watch.
groups.guard: One shared Plus-limit check used by every gated entry point and observed live, with a test listing every gated feature and its entry points.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Which features are free, Plus, gym member or Pro is decided in several places and no shared test checks who gets each lock.
groups.guard: One entitlement matrix test (free, Plus, gym member, Pro gym, trial ended) over every locked feature, on phone, panel and server.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Daily and hourly caps (questions, orders, messages, codes, crash reports, help) are each counted their own way and no test fills a cap to its edge.
groups.guard: One shared cap helper, and a test per cap that pre-fills it to the limit and checks the next try is refused with the right words and nothing saved.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Giving AI credits back is not tied to the task's real status, so a failed give-back leaves a task stuck and a worked task can still be refunded.
groups.guard: One credit-task state machine (waiting, done, failed, refunded) on the server, with tests for each move.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: HQ's AI limit form sends whole defaults instead of what was changed, so a blank box becomes 0 and trial limits are overwritten.
groups.guard: Send only changed fields, treat empty as empty, and test trial and blank cases.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: AI spend is counted in some places and not others, so the monthly cost is wrong.
groups.guard: Every AI call goes through one helper that records its cost, including failed tries.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: A spoken request that fails still uses up speaking time.
groups.guard: Charge speaking time only on success, with a test.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Rate limits and AI caps are one shared bucket per day, gym or whole product with no per-caller limit (and the real caller address is lost behind our server), and some endpoints answer anyone, so one outsider can use them up or get free AI.
groups.guard: Every public endpoint must have a per-caller limit before any shared ceiling, read the real caller address, and require a gym or member key for AI answers; a check lists every endpoint with its limits and an alert on spikes.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: Automatic and system messages draw from the gym's own daily member-message cap.
groups.guard: System messages get their own cap separate from the owner's.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: The hidden AI coach can be switched back on without safety rules, a report button, an app-side delete confirm, a live number check or a privacy-notice update, because no switch-on checklist exists.
groups.guard: A coach switch-on checklist test that fails while any of safety rules, report button, confirm-before-delete, live number check, outward-data marks and notice lines are missing.

groups.master_title: Paid features, limits and AI credits
groups.cause: The rule that a member needs classes left is checked only on the screen, so the server books personal training with none left.
groups.guard: Every limit a screen enforces is also enforced and tested on the server.

groups.cause: Whether a payment link or fee ask is open, paid online, expired, cancelled or failed is not one record every screen reads, so desk, shop, enquiry and member screens guess and show pay buttons, old UPI IDs or 'not paid' for money already taken.
groups.guard: Keep one payment-request status on the server that every desk and member screen reads (and re-reads on return), with a test for each status across the enquiry, shop, receipt and member screens.

groups.cause: The money records have no refunded or reversed state, so cancelling an online-paid receipt or order, a double payment, an over-payment or a wrongly confirmed payment leaves no way to record that money went back.
groups.guard: Add a refunded/reversed state to the payments ledger; every cancel or void path must check for an online payment and set it, guarded by a test per cancel path.
