groups.cause: Whether a payment is test or live is not carried with each payment, so test payments create real plans, receipts, member alerts and 'Paid' lines, and help and HQ treat test as real.
groups.guard: Store test-or-live on every payment and request and pass it to every plan, receipt, alert and screen; a test makes one test-mode payment and checks no surface treats it as real.

groups.cause: Cash taken on a desk without internet that the server later refuses (or never receives) has no proper state, so it vanishes from dues and counts, leaves receipt gaps or sits on a removed device unseen.
groups.guard: Give refused or unsent offline money its own visible state on the server and the member page, and warn before removing a device or going read-only while any is held.

groups.cause: Receipts, WhatsApp messages and hints each work out their own amounts, dates and plan names instead of reading one shared calculation, so they disagree with each other and the real plan.
groups.guard: One money summary function per member (due, plan, end date, saving, joining fee) used by every receipt and message template, with a test that compares every template's figures to it.

groups.cause: Payment words in messages, invites and posters are fixed text ('pay at the desk', 'or on UPI') and do not read the gym's online-pay switch or saved UPI ID.
groups.guard: Build every pay instruction from the gym's pay settings (in-app pay switch, UPI ID), with a test that flips each setting and checks every template.

groups.cause: Words about how people pay (at the desk or online, UPI or company) are fixed text on each screen instead of being read from the gym's one payment setting, so they go wrong when online paying is on.
groups.guard: One shared 'how this gym takes payment' helper that every pay sentence, help line and alert reads, with a test for each switch combination.

groups.cause: An offline or not-yet-confirmed receipt is handled differently on each payment screen, so one shows no receipt number and another lets it be sent.
groups.guard: One shared receipt-state helper (confirmed, waiting) used by every payment screen and the WhatsApp send.

groups.cause: A member paying the gym by UPI has no way to tell the gym.
groups.guard: Add an I-have-paid step that alerts the desk.

groups.cause: A free plan still offers online pay of zero rupees.
groups.guard: Hide online pay when the total is zero, with a test.

groups.cause: GST is split only when a receipt is printed, never stored, so monthly totals and exports cannot show it.
groups.guard: Store the GST split on each payment and read it in every money report.

groups.cause: Adding a GST number quietly makes every price GST-inclusive without telling the owner.
groups.guard: Any setting that changes how prices are read must say so on the setting and price boxes.

groups.cause: The assistant's add-member card does not recompute the joining fee when the plan changes.
groups.guard: A test that changing the plan on the card recomputes every fee.

groups.cause: The server keeps a history of receipt changes that no screen ever shows the owner.
groups.guard: Every record the server keeps for the owner has a screen or a journey saying why not.

groups.cause: A gym's plan, trial, branch and paid-until state is changed by many separate HQ and payment actions, each with its own logic, so hand plans, trials, branches, founding places and upgrades contradict each other and the promises.
groups.guard: Route every change to a gym's plan through one server function that enforces the plan rules (trial length, branch price, founding count, planned switches, paid-until in the future), with a table-driven test of every HQ action.

groups.cause: The gym's MettleUp plan state (waiting payment, plan switch, end reminder, open pay links) is decided in several places tied to online checkout, so UPI-paying gyms are treated wrongly.
groups.guard: One billing state machine on the server that all reminders and plan changes read, with tests for UPI, waiting and switch cases.

groups.cause: Member and gym status changes (leave, return, lapse, archive, pause, gym leaving) are not one state machine, so each feature handles them its own way and members stay archived, duplicate, lose marks or stay on machines and web pages.
groups.guard: One member and gym lifecycle state machine on the server that every feature subscribes to, plus a cross-role test that walks leave, return, lapse and pause through every feature.

groups.cause: Disconnecting the shop does not close it on the server.
groups.guard: Close the shop server-side on disconnect, with a test that blocks new orders.

groups.cause: The gym Pro pack switch is off and, when on, is enforced only on new rows and on the device, so Starter gyms keep Pro pages and the website sells them as Pro-only today.
groups.guard: Enforce the pack on the server for every create and update of Pro data, fail closed when the pack is unknown, and tie the website wording to the switch date.

groups.cause: Personal training packs are stored as membership plans and not linked to trainers, so plan readers count them and trainers never hear of them.
groups.guard: Give PT packs their own type, excluded by the shared plan reader and linked to the trainer, with a test.

groups.cause: Import reads a plan's length from the first number in its name.
groups.guard: Parse length only from length words, with a fixture set of real plan names.

groups.cause: The chart's opening range skips the free-plan check that later range changes run.
groups.guard: Run the plan check in one place for every range set.

groups.cause: Un-pause sets a fixed status instead of restoring the gym's earlier one.
groups.guard: Store and restore the prior status, with a test.

groups.cause: 'Stopped coming' counting ignores freezes, approved pauses, closed days and a new plan start, and is written by more than one rule.
groups.guard: One shared absence rule that subtracts pauses and closed days and restarts at a new plan, used everywhere, with tests.

groups.cause: Past pass visits read the member's current pass company instead of the one saved at the visit.
groups.guard: Records store the settings in force when they were made, with a test that changing a setting leaves history unchanged.

groups.cause: The forgotten-workout pause depends on the app being open and on timers that are only opened, so the workout keeps counting.
groups.guard: Run the idle pause from the workout's own clock in the notification service, tested with the app closed.

groups.cause: Gym-scoped data on the phone (logo, look, kept plan, hours, sync, what is sent) has no single owner, and no test moves a member from gym A to gym B.
groups.guard: One gym-switch test that joins gym A, switches to gym B and checks every gym-scoped store, header and outgoing call shows only gym B.

groups.cause: The assistant's wallet check is not reset when the owner switches gym.
groups.guard: Reset per-gym state on gym switch, with a test.

groups.cause: The server accepts role-limited actions and values (pass member, every-branch, door dates, offline flag, back-dated check-ins, option prices) exactly as the admin app sends them, so desk limits exist only on screen.
groups.guard: Check role and value for every write on the server (desk vs owner, dates from saved plans, prices from the catalogue), with a test that calls each write with a desk key and odd values.

groups.cause: Server reads return the same answer to every caller instead of shaping it by who asks, so the desk or a stranger learns more than their role should.
groups.guard: A role-by-function access matrix test that calls every read as owner, desk, trainer and stranger and checks the exact fields returned.

groups.cause: Who may see or do what (desk vs owner, branch access, pause rules) is decided screen by screen instead of from one permission rule.
groups.guard: One shared permission check that screens and words read, with a test per role on each guarded action.

groups.cause: Picture storage rules and upload tickets are not tied to one gym or to published pages, so tickets are reusable, drafts can be listed and another gym's logo can be used.
groups.guard: Storage rules require gym match and published state, tickets are single-file and gym-bound, unreferenced files are deleted, with a second-gym storage test.

groups.cause: The entry-machine link was built before a trust design: machines are identified by serial alone, punches can carry any date, and the link would be unencrypted.
groups.guard: An entry-machine launch checklist (gym-held pairing secret, bounded punch dates, encrypted link) that must pass before the machine service goes live.

groups.cause: Screens ship before the server part they call exists live, so a missing server piece reads as 'switched off' or a feature that does nothing.
groups.guard: A deploy check that every server function and table a screen calls exists on the live database before the screen can be switched on.

groups.cause: There is no rule that every gym-scoped call gets a test proving another gym or member is refused, and the read-everything test checks empty tables.
groups.guard: A generated test that calls every gym-scoped call and table with a second gym's and member's key against seeded rows and expects refusal.

groups.cause: Emergency access to a gym's records was built without matching the owner-facing promise or telling the owner, so the words promise consent that the button does not need.
groups.guard: One rule for emergency access (words, consent and an owner notice each time it opens) with a test that opening it writes the owner notice.

groups.cause: The data agreement promises every look at a gym's records is recorded and shown, but direct database reads, master-key reads and reads past a cap are not recorded and the record keeps raw query text.
groups.guard: Every read path to gym data writes to one access log (no cap, query values blanked) that the access card reads, with a test per read path.

groups.cause: The owner's access list and the HQ log read a fixed list of actions, so new kinds of look or change are left out.
groups.guard: Every HQ or direct look writes one shared access record and the owner list reads all kinds, with a test per kind.

groups.cause: Privileged actions write log rows but tests never read them back, and one action writes none.
groups.guard: Every privileged action test reads back its log row (who, what, masked fields), and a check fails for an action with no log line.

groups.cause: HQ writes the Log line before the change is checked and saved.
groups.guard: Write the audit line only after a successful change.

groups.cause: Branch-level and gym-level settings are not clearly scoped, so a change hits one branch only or a member is blocked at others.
groups.guard: One rule per setting saying gym-wide or per branch, shown on the screen and tested.

groups.cause: Pass visits do not store the pass company at check-in, so history is read from the member's current pass.
groups.guard: Write the company on the visit row, with a test that edits the member afterwards.

groups.cause: Dates and ages of readings are shown as day-and-month, time-only or raw day counts with no year or day, and a page's open line never refreshes.
groups.guard: One shared date formatter that adds the day or year when not today or this year and turns long gaps into months or years.

groups.cause: Calendar day cells read their raw date ('2026-11-03') to screen readers, because each calendar builds its own label instead of one spoken-date helper.
groups.guard: One shared spoken-date label used by every calendar.

groups.cause: The India-day and date rules are written out by hand in many places, some on the device or world clock.
groups.guard: One shared India-date module and a lint rule banning raw date maths elsewhere.

groups.cause: Date maths assumes an easy calendar: month-end starts lose days, festival lists end silently, and kept answers use the save day.
groups.guard: Shared date helpers for plan ends and lists with tests for 29-31 starts, 29 Feb, and a test that fails before listed years run out.

groups.cause: Dates and times use whatever clock is to hand (device clock, UTC, a 05:30 reset), because there is no shared India-day and server-time helper.
groups.guard: One shared time helper (server time, India day) used for every cut-off, label and export, with tests at midnight IST and with the device clock moved.

groups.cause: Tests wait on real time or read today's date, so they fail on slow machines or around midnight, or skip silently.
groups.guard: A shared fake clock required in tests, with a lint rule banning real waits and real dates.

groups.cause: Jobs and lists work only on a fixed recent window, so items older than it, including ones missed during an outage, quietly vanish.
groups.guard: Jobs process by 'not yet done' state, not by age window, with a test that runs after a long outage.

groups.cause: The service rests on one person's accounts, domains and single-copy keys with no written way back, so losing one account or key breaks the service.
groups.guard: A written, checked register of every account, domain and key with a second holder, a copy and replace steps, reviewed before launch.

groups.cause: Work that MettleUp must do by hand (credit top-ups, complaints, refunds, page reports, lock-outs, delete requests) arrives through general boxes with no queue, kind or tool in HQ.
groups.guard: Every hand-work request is a marked kind with its own HQ queue and Needs you count, and no screen may promise MettleUp action without that queue.

groups.cause: Outside icons, pictures, sounds, code packages and Hevy pages are used without a register of where they came from and what their licence asks, so credits and notices are missing.
groups.guard: One rights register built from the dependency list plus a hand list of assets, and a build step that fails when a shipped asset or package is missing from it or from the Credits page.

groups.cause: Logos, page photos, product photos and profile text go out to members with no rights or consent line and no report or hide step.
groups.guard: Every upload or public text box gets the shared rights/consent line and a report-and-hide control, checked by a test over all upload boxes.

groups.cause: Old ForgeAI assets and generic icons are still shipped, because no check lists the brand assets in use.
groups.guard: An asset check that fails on old-brand names or images and on missing icon shapes.

groups.cause: Personal data (names, ID numbers, typed numbers) is put into outgoing AI requests, download files or browser storage with no shared filter that strips it.
groups.guard: One shared filter for every outgoing request, export file and browser store, plus a test that searches each for names, mobiles and ID numbers.

groups.cause: Hiding names and numbers before sending to the AI is done separately in each call, so rewrites and some import columns send real details, and public lines claim the AI sees columns only.
groups.guard: One send-to-AI step that masks personal data for every call, with a test that no phone, email or name reaches any AI request, and public claims worded from it.

groups.cause: Text typed by members, desk staff or outside files (names, batch names, exercise names, help messages) is pasted into AI prompts as trusted facts with no fence, so it can steer the AI.
groups.guard: One shared prompt-builder that fences and trims every outside string and tells the AI it is data, with a test that a crafted name cannot change the output.

groups.cause: Raw request text is logged on parse errors, so personal data can land in the server log.
groups.guard: A log scrubber on every server log line, with a test using a phone number.

groups.cause: Save my history writes typed names into spreadsheet cells as-is, so a name starting with = runs as a formula.
groups.guard: All spreadsheet exports go through one writer that escapes formula signs.

groups.cause: Outage and key notes are posted in a public place.
groups.guard: Post outage notes only in the private crashes store.

groups.cause: Members can share the gym's own workout plans outside the gym with no gym check.
groups.guard: Owner decides the rule; share buttons on gym content follow it.

groups.cause: Small controls and tappable rows are drawn as plain text with no shared tap-row or text-button style, so they do not look tappable.
groups.guard: Shared tap-row and quiet-button components (arrow, underline or outline) and a design check that every pressable element uses one.

groups.cause: Icon buttons, card buttons, boxes and rows get no spoken name, or one that differs from what is shown, because components do not build the spoken name from their visible words and state.
groups.guard: Shared components that derive the spoken name and state from visible text, and an accessibility check that flags unnamed or mismatched controls.

groups.cause: Controls are sized one by one, so many fall under the 44/48-point finger size the apps already set as a rule.
groups.guard: Enforce the minimum touch size in the shared button components and add a measured tap-size check to the render and accessibility gates.

groups.cause: Results, errors and new answers appear without being read out (or are read out again every minute), because there is no shared announce line.
groups.guard: One shared live-message helper that announces changes once, used by every result and error line.

groups.cause: Form errors, limits and reasons are shown in a top banner, a placeholder, a stale warning or not at all, instead of at the field, because forms have no shared field-error pattern.
groups.guard: Shared field components that show the reason at the box, scroll to the first problem and clear stale warnings, used by every form sheet.

groups.cause: Charts, calendars, picked swatches, best sets and chat senders carry meaning only by colour, bar height, hover or touch, with no words or shape.
groups.guard: A rule that every visual-only meaning has a text or shape twin and a spoken summary, checked in the accessibility review.

groups.cause: Sheets, panels and page changes do not move or hold keyboard focus, because each opens and closes itself without a shared focus-trap helper.
groups.guard: Shared sheet and page components that move focus in, hold it and return it, with a keyboard check in the accessibility crawl.

groups.cause: Custom boxes and buttons wipe or recolour the keyboard focus ring instead of using one shared focus style.
groups.guard: One shared focus-ring style and a lint rule that bans removing outlines without it.

groups.cause: Text is sized in fixed pixels or with a fake scaling test, so it ignores the person's bigger text setting.
groups.guard: Size text from the system or browser base size, and test with the real text scaling.

groups.cause: Colour tokens are picked without a contrast check, so some words and badges are too faint in light or dark look.
groups.guard: A contrast check on every colour token pair in both looks.

groups.cause: Whole surfaces and screens (HQ, the phone app, the assistant, signed-out and newer panel pages) are left out of the automatic accessibility check.
groups.guard: The accessibility crawl takes its page list from the router of every surface, so new pages are included automatically.

groups.cause: Taps and links are pointed at screens by hand, and nothing checks they open the place their words name.
groups.guard: A test that every notification, link and button target opens the screen its words name.

groups.cause: Buttons and titles are fixed to one line, and no test renders them at big font on a narrow phone.
groups.guard: Render every screen at the largest font on a narrow phone in CI and fail on cut-off or overflowing text.

groups.cause: Sideways-scrolling rows hide items off the edge with no scroll bar, arrow or wrap.
groups.guard: Shared chip and photo rows that wrap or show a scroll cue on non-touch and narrow screens.

groups.cause: The coach mic works only while held, which a screen reader cannot do.
groups.guard: Offer tap-to-start and tap-to-stop recording.

groups.cause: Dragging an exercise in a live workout can drop it in the wrong place.
groups.guard: A real-finger drag test on the owner's phone size.

groups.cause: Closing a sheet, panel or form, or a rewrite, throws away what was typed or spoken, because sheets have no shared keep-the-draft or ask-before-closing rule.
groups.guard: A shared sheet behaviour that keeps drafts and asks before throwing away changes, tested by closing each sheet mid-entry.

groups.cause: Each input box parses numbers, phones and text itself, so Hindi digits, 'Rs.', decimal points, +91 and spaces are handled differently or wrongly.
groups.guard: One shared input reader for numbers, money, phones and codes used by every box, with one test table of awkward inputs.

groups.cause: Number boxes set their own limits, so some silently drop a too-big number and others accept impossible values.
groups.guard: One shared number field with declared limits that refuses and explains out-of-range values.

groups.cause: Lists and searches stop at a fixed cap without saying so, because the cap is set per query with no shared 'and N more' pattern.
groups.guard: Every capped list returns its true total and shows an 'and N more' line, checked by a test that a capped result carries its total.

groups.cause: Lists stop at a fixed newest-N with no paging, so counts and older items are cut off.
groups.guard: Every list either pages or says it is cut off, and counts come from the server, not the capped list.

groups.cause: The quick-buttons sheet lists rows in a fixed order, ignoring the chosen order.
groups.guard: List chosen buttons in their order, with a test.

groups.cause: Swapping the before and after photos skips the older-first rule, so the newer photo can be called Before.
groups.guard: Keep the pair in time order after any swap, with a test.

groups.cause: Hand-made pick-one lists, toggles and folds lack the proper roles, open/closed state and arrow keys, because there is no shared choice component.
groups.guard: Shared radio-group, toggle and fold components with roles, states and arrow keys, checked by the accessibility crawl.

groups.cause: Some records can only be added, never edited or closed (a staff job name, a branch).
groups.guard: A rule that every added record kind gets edit and close paths, checked in design review.

groups.cause: Some ways of adding a member never ask for fields that later features need (birthday, body figure).
groups.guard: A list of fields each feature needs, checked against every add path.

groups.cause: Branding previews only the dark look.
groups.guard: Preview both themes.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: Backlog, feature list and planning notes are kept by hand and never re-derived from code and switches, so they say things are live, built, switched off or private when they are not.
groups.guard: Derive the Live and Hidden rows of the feature list from the feature switches and code, and require every 'live' row to cite a test or switch.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: The feature map and set-up notes are hand-kept, not read from live state, so they say things are off or waiting that are live.
groups.guard: Generate the feature map from live switches and the live database, with a check that fails when they disagree.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: The list of live features and the 'not live' notes are kept by hand, so removed, hidden or now-live features are still listed wrongly and their help and leftover code linger.
groups.guard: Derive the feature register's live/hidden/removed status from the actual feature switches and fail a check when a listed live feature has no reachable screen.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: Things decided or called worth building (teen accounts, QR location check, class booking) sit in the backlog with no owner, date or parked decision.
groups.guard: Every backlog decision row carries an owner and a decide-by date, and a weekly check lists rows past their date.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: When a feature is switched off, retired or renamed, its code paths, buttons and stored names stay behind with no gate.
groups.guard: A retirement checklist that searches for the feature's screens, tables, buttons and old names and either gates or removes each one.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: There is no dead-code check, so unused and switched-off code, some kept alive only by its own tests, piles up.
groups.guard: A dead-code check in CI that fails on unused exports and on tests that guard only unused code.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: Old paths (the ForgeAI app, the Drive restore) are retired by date without a plan for the people still on them.
groups.guard: Retire an old path only after a move-off screen and a usage check, written in the release plan.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: Small rules and helpers are copied by hand into several files and have drifted apart.
groups.guard: A duplicate-code check in CI that fails when a known helper is written again.

groups.master_title: Internal notes, maps and dead code
groups.cause: A workout's name is worked out separately on each screen and copy (History, trainer, Health Connect, gym plan), so renames do not travel.
groups.guard: One naming function and a rename that updates every copy, tested on each screen.

groups.cause: Gym pause, unpaid lock, Pro and Plus locks and page-off are checked screen by screen, so new screens and server paths miss them.
groups.guard: One server-side entitlement check that every read and write passes through, with a table test for each lock against each feature.

groups.cause: Member choices (units, hidden exercises, machine steps, goals, snoozes, sharing) are read separately by each feature, so newer features miss them.
groups.guard: One shared member-preferences reader and a test listing every feature that must honour each preference.

groups.cause: Owner settings (AI limits, trial, offers, language, message calm, alerts, defaults) are read separately by each feature or hard-coded, so some features ignore them.
groups.guard: One shared gym-settings reader with defaults on the server, and a test listing every feature that must honour each setting.

groups.cause: The iPhone app is built on Android-only assumptions (update path, payment, Apple sign-in, notifications, iCloud backup, permission reasons) with no iPhone launch checklist.
groups.guard: An iPhone launch checklist test that fails while any Android-only path lacks an iPhone version.

groups.cause: Invite links have no iPhone path that keeps the gym.
groups.guard: An invite-link test per platform.
